# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and font reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 improves Linux font discovery and updates its Tizen 10 native build support. It also integrates the current m155 native fork cleanup, keeping the bundled rendering engine aligned for the next release line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **m155 native fork cleanup integrated** — Updates the bundled Skia fork cleanup for the 4.155 line, keeping the native rendering engine current. ([#5208](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5208))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux system-font discovery restored** — NoDependencies Linux packages can again discover fonts installed on the system. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))

## Platform

- **Tizen 10 native builds updated** — Tizen 10 packages are built and packaged with the required GCC 14.2 toolchain. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))
